title: Test oracle is external spec, not derived from code under test
description: Integration tests (integration.rs comments on lines 254-255, 283-284) explicitly state JSON fixtures are 'hand-constructed from the Tailscale LocalAPI spec — not derived from running the code under test.' This is correct test discipline per project rules. Test vectors are independent oracles. Unit tests (lib.rs lines 229-250) also use spec-based fixtures. Keep this discipline when expanding tests.
